steps.text: Talk to Marlo in the Estate agent's house in north-east Varrock.
chat: 2. What kind of favour do you want me to do?
3. Tell me more about the job.
3. Tell me where he lives, and I'll do the job.

steps.text: Pick up the saw in the house if needed.
Talk to Old Man Yarlo in his house south-west of Aubury's Rune Shop.
Remove all 7 old furnishings:
1 broken chair.
1 rotten carpet.
2 broken stools.
2 broken tables.
1 campbed.
Talk to Old Man Yarlo again.
chat: 2. Skip Yarlo's lecture. He'll offer it later if you like.

steps.text: Search the crates marked with a black symbol, west of the range, for 3 waxwood logs.
Go to the Varrock sawmill and talk to the Sawmill operator.
chat: 1. I need some waxwood planks for Old Man Yarlo.

steps.text: Have the Sawmill operator convert the 3 waxwood logs into 3 waxwood planks.
If needed, use an axe to chop 10 nearby trees and have the Sawmill operator convert the 10 logs into 10 planks for 1,000 coins.
If needed, buy enough supplies from his shop to have 5 bolts of cloth and 100 steel nails.
Return to Old Man Yarlo's house and build the new furniture at every white, translucent hotspot.
If you lack a hammer or saw, ask Old Man Yarlo for tools.
Talk to Old Man Yarlo after building all the furniture.
Return to Marlo and claim the reward.
chat: 1. Yeah, what have you got for me?

steps.text: Congratulations, miniquest complete!
